lead: Subrahmanyam Jaishankar is an Indian diplomat, born on 9 January 1955 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has held the office of Minister of External Affairs and has been recognised with the Padma Shri in civil service.
